column3: Android 15 — a clean phone: no Termux, no server
Install OpenCode Mobile
Open the app
Where does the agent run? On this phone
One button — Customize to add AI Team
Switch on AI Team — the totals update
Now it includes AI Team — Set up
Setting up with real progress: Linux, Git, Python, Node.js, OpenCode, AI Team
OpenCode is ready — about 6½ minutes, AI Team included
Create the first project: my-app
Straight into a new conversation in my-app
Settings → Plugins: turn on AI Team for this project
Turning on AI Team: it starts the team for my-app
AI Team · Running — works on my-app (about 9 minutes to turn on)
Work tab → the AI Team card → Open
Start a run: give the team one task
Task: Create hello.py that prints Hello from the AI Team
Sent. Waiting for an agent to take it
An agent took the task (6 min after sending) and works on its own branch
hello.py written on its branch (polecat/ma-7mr); handing off to the merge
Waiting for merge: the refinery agent reviews and merges
Merged into master: feat: add hello.py greeting. (Finished runs leave this list: known issue)
See it in the project: ask the agent to pull and run it
The agent pulls the team's merge and runs hello.py
Done: the team's commit is in my-app and runs — Hello from the AI Team
